# CleanBG

> Free in-browser background remover. Photos are never uploaded.

Processing uses MIT-licensed ONNX models (BEN2, BiRefNet Lite) via Transformers.js and ONNX Runtime Web in a Web Worker on your device. There is no image upload API. Chinese pages live under /zh/.

## Tool

- [CleanBG background remover](https://cleanbg.app/): Remove image backgrounds in your browser; images stay on your device.
- [White background](https://cleanbg.app/white-background): Export cutouts on a white background for product and profile photos.
- [Transparent PNG](https://cleanbg.app/transparent-png): Export a transparent PNG cutout from a photo.
- [Logo background removal](https://cleanbg.app/logo): Remove backgrounds from logos in the browser.
- [Portrait background](https://cleanbg.app/passport-photo): Portrait cutouts for photos (not an official ID photo service).
- [iPhone HEIC](https://cleanbg.app/iphone-heic): Remove backgrounds from iPhone HEIC photos in the browser.
- [Blog](https://cleanbg.app/blog): Guides on background removal, privacy, and running AI in the browser.

## Blog

- [How in-browser background removal works](https://cleanbg.app/blog/how-in-browser-background-removal-works): Explains local models, WebGPU, ONNX, caching, and privacy.
- [A no-upload background remover](https://cleanbg.app/blog/no-upload-background-remover): Discusses local processing and privacy considerations for background removal.
- [Remove backgrounds from product photos](https://cleanbg.app/blog/remove-background-from-product-photos): A browser-based workflow for product image cutouts and exports.
- [Batch-remove backgrounds in the browser](https://cleanbg.app/blog/batch-remove-backgrounds-in-browser): Describes local image queues, mask editing, and ZIP downloads.
- [CleanBG vs remove.bg vs Canva](https://cleanbg.app/blog/cleanbg-vs-remove-bg-and-canva): Compares background removal tools, including privacy, cost, and batch workflows.
- [remove.bg shutdown and alternatives](https://cleanbg.app/blog/remove-bg-shutting-down-alternative): Covers the announced shutdown and options for continuing background removal.

## Optional
